scripts.build: npm run build:demo && npm run build:lib && npm run build:location-search && npm run build:search-engine && npm run build:geometry-editor && npm run build:sketch
scripts.build:lib: vue-tsc --noEmit && LIB_MINIFY=0 vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && LIB_MINIFY=1 vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts
scripts.build:location-search: vue-tsc --noEmit && LIB_MINIFY=0 vite build --config vite.location-search.config.ts && LIB_MINIFY=1 vite build --config vite.location-search.config.ts
scripts.build:search-engine: vue-tsc --noEmit && LIB_MINIFY=0 vite build --config vite.search-engine.config.ts && LIB_MINIFY=1 vite build --config vite.search-engine.config.ts
scripts.build:geometry-editor: vue-tsc --noEmit && LIB_MINIFY=0 vite build --config vite.geometry-editor.config.ts && LIB_MINIFY=1 vite build --config vite.geometry-editor.config.ts
scripts.build:sketch: vue-tsc --noEmit && LIB_MINIFY=0 vite build --config vite.sketch.config.ts && LIB_MINIFY=1 vite build --config vite.sketch.config.ts
scripts.serve:pages: npm run build:demo:pages && npm run preview:pages
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
